# Nugget Wallpaper

> Nugget Wallpaper is a curated library of animated, motion and dynamic wallpapers for iPhone and iPad, installed with the open-source Nugget tool. Supports iOS and iPadOS 17 through 26 without a jailbreak. The full browseable gallery, previews and downloads live on mwallx.com.

## Key pages

- [Nugget Wallpaper (English)](https://nuggetwallpaper.github.io/): What Nugget Wallpaper is, how to install animated wallpapers with the Nugget tool, and links to the wallpaper library.
- [简体中文](https://nuggetwallpaper.github.io/zh-CN/): Nugget 壁纸简介与安装指南（简体中文）。
- [हिन्दी](https://nuggetwallpaper.github.io/hi/): Nugget वॉलपेपर परिचय और इंस्टॉल गाइड।
- [Español](https://nuggetwallpaper.github.io/es/): Introducción a Nugget Wallpaper y guía de instalación.
- [Français](https://nuggetwallpaper.github.io/fr/): Présentation de Nugget Wallpaper et guide d'installation.
- [العربية](https://nuggetwallpaper.github.io/ar/): مقدمة عن Nugget Wallpaper ودليل التثبيت.
- [বাংলা](https://nuggetwallpaper.github.io/bn/): Nugget ওয়ালপেপার পরিচিতি ও ইনস্টল গাইড।
- [Português](https://nuggetwallpaper.github.io/pt/): Introdução ao Nugget Wallpaper e guia de instalação.
- [Русский](https://nuggetwallpaper.github.io/ru/): Описание Nugget Wallpaper и руководство по установке.
- [اردو](https://nuggetwallpaper.github.io/ur/): Nugget وال پیپر کا تعارف اور انسٹال گائیڈ۔

## Product data

- Wallpaper gallery and downloads: [mwallx.com](https://mwallx.com/)
- Install tutorial: [Nugget Host tutorial](https://nugget.host/tutorial/nugget)
- Nugget tool (open source): [github.com/leminlimez/Nugget](https://github.com/leminlimez/Nugget)

## Facts (verifiable)

- Nugget Wallpaper requires the Nugget tool; no jailbreak is needed.
- Supported versions: iOS and iPadOS 17 through 26 (up to iOS 26.1). The Nugget tool is NOT compatible with iOS 27.
- Deployment: GitHub Pages static site; theme = dynamic/motion wallpapers.
